verdict.rationale: No evidence shows Sentry offers a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows (e.g., scheduled reports, cron-style automation, or workflow scheduling); alerts are event-triggered (sentry-docs-21) and dashboards are static views (sentry-docs-4), not scheduled recurring tasks. missing for 10: any documentation of scheduled/recurring job or workflow creation, cron-based automation, or periodic digest/report scheduling.
